title: Mist Driver Proteus Simulation
objective: Validate the mist driver control circuit in Proteus before firmware handoff.
hypothesis: The staged driver circuit will switch cleanly and expose only minor timing adjustments before PCB validation.
test_plan: Simulate the load, capture switching waveforms, compare against the expected control profile, and record follow-up actions.
setup_notes: Proteus simulation prepared with the current driver schematic and staged load model.
results: Simulation is running with expected timing behaviour.
conclusion: Awaiting final comparison against bench results.
lesson_learned: Proteus can shorten the path to PCB confidence when the load model is kept simple.
